kicker: THINK YOU'RE TOO OLD TO START LIFTING?
title: 90-year-olds got *174% stronger*

text: 10 nursing home residents, average age 90. Heavy leg training 3 times a week for *8 weeks.*

label: WHY IT MATTERS
head: 10 days in bed cost a 67-year-old 1 kg of leg muscle
sub: Young adults took 28 days to lose that much. Muscle is your reserve.

label: THE MINIMUM
head: Lift 2 days a week, at any age
sub: Legs first: squats to a chair, step-ups, leg press.

text: You're 25 and think it's too late? *They were 90.*
